description: Source code for MediaKeySession class implementing DRM session management, key handling, and decryption functions, with platform-specific crypto integrations.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Manages DRM media key sessions, including creation, update, decryption, and key management.

methods.name: CreateSessionId
methods.description: Generates a unique session ID based on a static counter.

methods.name: MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor initializing session with provided init data.

methods.name: ~MediaKeySession
methods.description: Destructor handling cleanup, including platform-specific crypto shutdown.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the session, optionally with a callback, spawning a thread for message handling.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates session with key response data, extracts keys, and notifies callback.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-CTR decryption of media data using session keys.

methods.description: Frees memory for clear content buffer.
